svg.title: Figure 3. Logical components and information flows
svg.desc: Logical capabilities of a university learning assistant platform and the flows between them: student, identity and authorization, student interaction, configuration assembly reading versioned configurations, approved materials access, model and tools inside a provider boundary, operational measurement, feedback intake, protected review inside a protected records boundary, synthetic investigation and evaluation inside a synthetic experiments boundary, and improvement and release feeding versioned configurations.
svg.text: Logical capabilities, not products. Three boundaries govern what may cross and who may see it.
response, with citations to approved materials
Reference design; identifiers are illustrative (fictional Wrenfield University).
